message.reasoning:
The user wants to find out the rewards for playing Fortnite on Playstation platform with different missions and trophies. We need to use the function game_rewards_get. The arguments: game="Fortnite", platform="Playstation". The mission and trophy default to empty strings. But we might want to get info for different missions and trophies. The user says "with different missions and trophies" - maybe they want to list all possible rewards? The function signature allows specifying mission or trophy. If we call it with no mission or trophy, it will return all rewards? The description: "Retrieve information about different types of rewards that you can receive when playing a certain game." It doesn't specify if mission or trophy are optional filters. They default to '' meaning unspecified. So calling with just game and platform should give all rewards. That seems appropriate.

Thus we call functions.game_rewards_get with game="Fortnite", platform="Playstation". No mission or trophy specified. Then we output the result.
